skills.summary: Edit prose for clarity without changing voice
skills.job: Make unclear sentences and paragraphs say one thing plainly, keeping the author's voice and meaning.
gotchas: Fixing words when the structure is the problem

skills.summary: Cut text to a target length
skills.job: Cut a text to a word or character limit while keeping the points that matter.
gotchas: Hitting the count by deleting the conclusion

skills.summary: Build a working outline before drafting
skills.job: Turn a topic, notes or a brief into an outline with a clear argument per section.
gotchas: Outline that mirrors the notes' order

skills.job: Produce several honest headline options for a piece and pick one that fits the audience and channel.
gotchas: Promise the piece does not keep
Length that truncates in search or feeds

skills.job: Write a standalone abstract of a paper or report that states question, method, result and meaning.
gotchas: Describing the paper instead of its findings

skills.job: Draft a press release with a news lead, quotes the user supplies and complete contact details.
Write one newsletter issue with a subject line, a lead item and short sections for a defined audience.
triggers: turn these updates into a newsletter

skills.job: Write product descriptions from supplied specs, covering what it is, who it fits and the facts a buyer checks.
triggers: describe this item for the shop

skills.job: Turn a list of changes into release notes organised by what the user can now do.
Write a how-to guide that gets a reader from a stated starting point to a working result in tested steps.

skills.summary: Build an FAQ from real questions
skills.job: Build an FAQ from real support questions, grouped and answered directly with the answer first.
triggers: turn these support tickets into an FAQ

skills.job: Shape an essay, case or talk around a narrative spine of tension, turn and payoff using only true material.
triggers: give my article a narrative arc
structure a story from these facts

skills.job: Find the weak links in an argument, state the strongest objection and repair the case with real evidence.
gotchas: Attacking a weaker version of the claim

skills.job: Rewrite technical, bureaucratic or dense text so a general reader can act on it, with a reading level check.
gotchas: Replacing a term with a vague phrase

skills.summary: Check text against a style guide
skills.job: Check a document against a named or supplied style guide and report each deviation with a fix.
triggers: check this against our style guide
gotchas: Applying rules the guide leaves optional

skills.summary: Write a README that gets people started
skills.job: Write or revise a README from the actual project so a new reader can install, run and find help.
gotchas: Badges and sections with nothing behind them

skills.summary: Write a technical blog post with working code
skills.job: Write a technical post around one problem and one solution, with code that was run.
triggers: blog about how we built this
explain this technique in a post

skills.summary: Write a customer case study from facts
skills.job: Write a case study with situation, action and measured result, using only figures and quotes the client approved.
triggers: turn this project into a case study

skills.summary: Prepare interview questions for a source
skills.job: Prepare research-backed, open interview questions in an order that builds, with follow-ups.
triggers: prepare an interview with an expert
what should I ask this person
